authors_reviews.title: Sleek, Reliable, and Easy to Use!
authors_reviews.text: This rechargeable electric lighter works great and has quickly become one of my favorite household tools. It charges quickly, holds a long-lasting charge, and lights candles with ease—no more struggling with traditional lighters. The long design makes it easy to reach deep candle jars while keeping your hands safely away from the flame. It's lightweight, stylish, and simple to operate. Overall, it's a convenient, reusable alternative to disposable lighters, and I would definitely recommend it!
authors_reviews.author: Lauren Koehler

authors_reviews.title: Fantastic inventive product I recommend 100%.
authors_reviews.text: (MEIRUBY) the manufacturer I have to say made a sturdy, durable, and lightweight easy to use product. Easy to charge which is long lasting charge life. Lights candles so easily and it’s cool to watch it spark and ignite the wick of the candle. Safe to use with a simple switch that covers the on and off button so young children cannot easily power up and start a fire. The length lets you get down to a used candle wick without burning fingers or hands. Does not use fuel so there is no refilling or throwing away once used up. Comes in different colors and it definitely was a great stocking stuffer.
authors_reviews.author: CW

authors_reviews.title: Great lighter for candles and cigarettes!
authors_reviews.text: Great lighter, lights cigarettes and candles with no problems. Charged very fast and heard it holds a long charge so we shall see.

authors_reviews.title: Prongs need to be wider
authors_reviews.text: Works really well to light candles - I wish the arc/prongs were wider though. I can see why it stops working for some people because it's really easy to dirty up the points. The prongs are barely the width of the wick. Other than that, so far so good!

other_countries_reviews.title: Fini de chercher des allumettes ou un briquet partout !
other_countries_reviews.text: Depuis que j’ai cet allume-feu électrique, je me demande comment j’ai pu m’en passer aussi longtemps ! 😅Avec une plaque à induction à la maison, je n’ai aucune raison d’avoir constamment des allumettes ou un briquet sous la main. Résultat : chaque fois que je voulais allumer une bougie, je passais mon temps à chercher une boîte d’allumettes dans les tiroirs ou j’attendais que mon mari soit dans les parages pour lui emprunter son briquet.J’ai choisi celui-ci en rose et maintenant il a sa place dans mon tiroir. Je sais toujours où il est et il est immédiatement prêt à servir. Je l’utilise pour mes bougies, de la sauge et tout ce qui nécessite une petite flamme.Il fonctionne très bien et surtout, l’autonomie est excellente. Je l’ai depuis un bon moment et je crois que je ne l’ai rechargé qu’une seule fois. La recharge USB est également beaucoup plus pratique que de devoir penser à racheter des briquets ou des allumettes.J’aime aussi son format fin et discret. Il prend très peu de place et peut facilement être emporté en voyage ou en camping.Bref, un tout petit objet qui m’a simplifié la vie beaucoup plus que je ne l’aurais imaginé. Je le recommande vraiment ! 😊
other_countries_reviews.author: Nora

other_countries_reviews.title: UPDATED REVIEW* Really cool device, lots of pros, only one con
other_countries_reviews.text: SECOND UPDATE: Okay so I see now how you can burn the lighter. I put the torch into the candle completely vertical and when the wick was lit the flame started melting the lighter. To avoid this, make sure you are using the lighter on a slight angle. It should never be perfectly vertical.UPDATE: been using this lighter for about 5 months and still love it. No issues. I saw a review where someone says it stopped working after 2 months, maybe they got a defective one. Saw another photo of someone's that was completely toasted and my first thought was "what the hell did you stick it in?!?!" LOL I can only imagine that happening if you are using it improperly.I love this little thing. Pros:- It's about the size of a pen- The actual lighter part is concealed until you are ready to use it- 4 lights show battery remaining- can charge with any usb-c cable- plasma is so cool, it would be a good gift- just as good as a regular lighter but easier to use cuz you just push a button rather than snapping a lighter striker (which can sometimes get so hawt they burn your thumb)- no burning your finger/awkward maneaouvering to not burn your finger so that you can light that candle wick all the way at the bottom of the jar 🤣Cons:- battery doesn't last as many uses as I thought it would. Maybe about 50 uses. The description sounded like it would be moreOverall super happy with this cool device
other_countries_reviews.author: Skip Helps
